create_ClassyDataset: create a ClassyDataset instance wrapping a PyTorch dataset with batch size, shuffle, and transform config
parse_config_ClassyDataset: parse a config dict to extract batchsize_per_replica, shuffle, num_samples, and transform settings
iterator_ClassyDataset: get a PyTorch DataLoader iterator with distributed sampling and configurable shuffle seed and epoch
get_global_batchsize_ClassyDataset: get the global batch size across all replicas by multiplying per-replica batch size by world size
set_num_workers_ClassyDataset: set the number of worker processes used by the ClassyDataset DataLoader for data loading
